seo.titulo: I Went to the Field — contar o que você fez no passado em inglês — Aula 16 Agro English
seo.descricao: Passado irregular em inglês para contar um dia de trabalho: I went, I drove, I found, I bought, Did you see…? Aula 16 do curso Agro English da Capy English, com diálogo em áudio.

hero.sub: Segunda de manhã, o Jack quer saber do seu sábado: a viagem até a fazenda, o trator sem sinal, o cabo comprado na cidade. Contar o que você fez com os verbos irregulares no passado.

dialogo.sub: 🛻 Na oficina, segunda de manhã: o Jack pergunta do fim de semana e você conta a viagem até a Fazenda Boa Vista. Ouça antes de ler a tradução.

expressoesSub: Frases prontas para contar o que você fez. Uma por slide.

vocab.ex: I went to a farm on Saturday.
I saw a lot of sugarcane.
I bought a new cable in town.
I went there two weeks ago.
Did he pay for the spare part?
His tractor lost the GPS signal.
I saw a lot of sugarcane.

expressoes.pt: Como foi seu fim de semana?
expressoes.usage: was é o passado de is. É a pergunta clássica da segunda de manhã
expressoes.example: Good morning! How was your weekend?

expressoes.usage: went é o passado de go. Verbo irregular: não leva -ed
expressoes.example: I went to a farm on Saturday.

expressoes.usage: did + verbo puro: did you find, did you see. O did já mostra que é passado

expressoes.expr: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.
expressoes.usage: resposta curta para pergunta com did. didn't = did not
expressoes.example: Did you have a new cable? — No, I didn't.

expressoes.usage: distância em tempo. from here = daqui
expressoes.example: The farm is two hours from here.

expressoes.usage: reação de empatia. had é o passado de have
expressoes.example: I got home at nine. — You had a long day!

gramatica.titulo: Patterns: contar o que você fez

personagens.LUAN: a young Brazilian man (early twenties, brown skin, short curly black hair, dark green work shirt)
personagens.JACK: an American man (forties, light skin, plain dark teal baseball cap, orange and green plaid flannel shirt)
personagens.FARMER: an older Brazilian farmer (sixties, tan skin, white mustache, straw hat, light blue shirt)

gramatica.cenaAbertura: In a GPS repair workshop on a Monday morning, {LUAN} shows photos on his phone to {JACK}, who holds a cup of coffee and smiles.

slides.cena: {LUAN} drives a white pickup truck on a dirt road between tall green sugarcane fields at sunrise.

frases.en: I **went** to a farm on Saturday.

frases.en: I **bought** a new cable in town.

slides.cena: At a simple farmhouse table, {FARMER} serves a plate of rice, beans and meat to {LUAN}.

frases.pt: O trator perdeu o sinal de GPS.
O fazendeiro fez almoço para mim.

frases.en: Jack **came** to the workshop on Monday.

slides.cena: {JACK} asks questions with curiosity, pointing at a map on the workshop wall, while {LUAN} answers with a smile.

slides.padrao: I **didn't have** · Yes, I **did** · No, I **didn't**
slides.cena: {LUAN} shakes his head with a small smile next to an open toolbox, holding a broken cable in his hand.

lacunas.texto: On Saturday, Luan [[went]] to Boa Vista Farm. He [[drove]] the pickup truck and [[left]] home at six. The farmer's tractor had a problem: it [[lost]] the GPS signal. Luan looked at the machine and [[found]] the problem quickly. The antenna cable was broken. He [[didn't have]] a new cable, so he [[bought]] one in town. The farmer was very happy and made lunch for him. Luan [[got]] home late, but he took great photos of the sugarcane fields.

livre.pedido: Escreva 2 frases sobre o que você fez no último fim de semana (passado irregular).
livre.exemplo: Last weekend I went to my parents' house. We had lunch together.

escrita.dica: Escreva 3 ou 4 frases para o Jack contando um dia de trabalho fora da oficina: aonde foi, como foi, o que encontrou e o que comprou. Use went, drove, found e bought.
escrita.exemplo:
On Friday I went to a farm near Rio Verde.
I drove the pickup truck.
I found a problem with the GPS antenna.
I bought a new cable in town.

preparacao.aquecimento: Aonde você foi no último fim de semana? O que você fez?
preparacao.exemplo: Last weekend I went to a rodeo.
